keyword: nba rookie of the year odds
claims: As of early April 2026, Dallas Mavericks rookie Cooper Flagg is the betting favorite to win NBA Rookie of the Year at -250 odds at DraftKings.
Cooper Flagg had 51-point and 45-point games during a weekend.
Cooper Flagg has surpassed Charlotte Hornets guard Kon Knueppel, who is second at +180 odds.
Prior to April 2026, Kon Knueppel led the NBA Rookie of the Year race.
Prior to April 2026, some polls showed Kon Knueppel having over 80% of first-place votes.
Consecutive 45+ point games by Cooper Flagg shifted the odds significantly.
According to CBS Sports, Cooper Flagg is on track to become the first rookie since Michael Jordan to lead his team in points, rebounds, assists, and steals.
DraftKings 2025-26 NBA Rookie of the Year odds in April 2026 list Cooper Flagg (Mavericks) at -250.
DraftKings 2025-26 NBA Rookie of the Year odds in April 2026 list Kon Knueppel (Hornets) at +180.
DraftKings 2025-26 NBA Rookie of the Year odds in April 2026 list VJ Edgecombe (76ers) at +50000.
DraftKings 2025-26 NBA Rookie of the Year odds in April 2026 list Ace Bailey at +900.
DraftKings 2025-26 NBA Rookie of the Year odds in April 2026 list Tre Johnson at +1100.
The Polymarket market for Rookie of the Year is expected to close on or around May 17, 2026.
